author: PAUL NEWBERRY - Associated Press
title: Bryce Elder is pitching like an All-Star again
text:
• Bryce Elder is pitching well, reminiscent of his 2023 season.
• Elder had four dominating starts.
• Elder was considered the weak link in the Atlanta rotation.
• Elder had a 9-16 record in the last two seasons.
• Elder's ERA is at 2.45, with 39 strikeouts in 33 innings.
• Elder has allowed 36 hits and 10 earned runs.
• Elder's last two starts were strong.
